title: Get fast proof of Intent collected scope timing and chart marks

intentCoverage.report:
## Intent Coverage report (checked revision 973e1faf8521a5b90ef5409def842504c9d33d7f)

Verdict: Caught (on the dark pass of the Project chart-mark case).

Promise: SEED-413#speed-intent-scope-timing-reading, Key example 5, "Marks stay painted with focus in light and dark". Revision 973e1faf8521a5b90ef5409def842504c9d33d7f, plan 777.

Fault: dashboard/src/history-chart.css, :root chart tokens. --history-chart-mark, -ring, -grid, -words and -failed were pinned to their light hex values (#1b5fa8, #ffffff, #c9c9c1, #55554f, #9b1c1c) instead of var(--accent/--raised-surface/--line/--quiet/--problem). As a result, the marks ignore prefers-color-scheme: dark while the chart surface still turns dark. Fixtures and assertions were left unchanged.

Maintained check examined: dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-project-ci-history-chart-marks.spec.ts:72-79, the light/dark loop with `expect.poll(chart.painting).toEqual({...all true})` (painting() is in intent-scope-history-chart-page.ts:128). This assertion caught the fault.

Commands (scratch detached worktree at the revision, npm ci, Node 24.21.0): `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES caffeinate -s -i npm run --silent test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-project-ci-history-chart-marks.spec.ts --workers=2`, plus an untracked scratch witness spec run with the same command. The witness mounted the same chart, emulated each scheme and logged computed colours and contrast.

Observations:
- Baseline: 2/2 passed (Vitest duration 20.67 s).
- Reach: the unfaulted witness showed that emulateMedia really switches the scheme. In dark, matchMedia dark was true, the chart surface was rgb(25,33,48), the mark fill rgb(196,210,255) and the failed stroke rgb(240,168,168).
- Independent wrong-behaviour witness (faulted, dark): the surface was rgb(25,33,48), but the mark fill stayed rgb(27,95,168) at contrast 2.50 (it was 10.76). The failed × stayed rgb(155,28,28) at contrast 1.98, and the hollow fill stayed rgb(255,255,255), a white disc on the dark surface. The light pass was identical to the unfaulted run.
- Faulted focused run 1: failed for an unrelated reason. `openScopeSummary` timed out polling for the location name control (intent-scope-history-page.ts:134) before reaching the scheme loop. Load average was about 44/38/31. No verdict was drawn from this run.
- Faulted focused run 2: failed at spec.ts:74. painting() received {failedInProblemColour:false, hollowOnSurface:false, marksRead:false, readoutRead:true}. Under the fault the light pass yields exactly the light tokens, so this failure is the dark iteration.

Restoration: scratch file restored after each faulted run, witness spec deleted, `git diff --quiet` clean at 973e1fa. The restored focused run passed 2/2 (Vitest 14.06 s). Scratch worktree removed.

Next proof action: none needed for this fault path. The maintained dark pass detects a chart that ignores dark colours.

Costs: test runtime baseline 20.67 s, faulted run 1 22.18 s, restored 14.06 s; baseline wall clock including startup 32.1 s. Human and agent effort unavailable. Invocation-to-report elapsed 326790 ms (measured).

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision 973e1faf. Verdict Caught; no new or stronger proof is needed for the checked fault path. The run-1 timeout of `openScopeSummary`'s default `expect.poll` wait at load about 44 is a local load flake, which the failure policy treats as a defect. It is added to the queued correction [plan 783](../slice-plans/783-correct-scope-timing-chart-proof-residue/PLAN.md) (SEED-413#correct-scope-timing-chart-proof-residue) as finding 6, within its proof-residue outcome. The probe also narrows that plan's finding 3 to an app that ignores the scheme entirely.
